title: Blue Knuckles Sport Fishing Charter

services.name: Fishing Trips
services.desc: Located between Santa Cruz and Monterey, our charters launch from Moss Landing, putting our boat close to some of the richest fishing grounds in the world. The Monterey Canyon, one of the deepest underwater canyons in North America, is just minutes from our dock. That means more fishing, less travel time. Blue Knuckles Sport Fishing offers world-class angling adventures across some of California’s most productive and breathtaking waters. From the kelp-rich reefs and canyons of Monterey Bay to the dramatic coastline off Big Sur and the deep blue offshore grounds where tuna roam, we tailor each trip to deliver the ultimate sportfishing experience.
